item.text: win_stay_lose_shift Uses win-stay, lose-shift behavior: cooperate after mutually cooperative rounds or successful defections, and switch after receiving a poor payoff. This preserves cooperation with reciprocal opponents while quickly adapting to persistent defection. ```python # EVOLVE-BLOCK-START def policy(own_history, opponent_history): if len(opponent_history) == 0: return 0 if opponent_history[-1] == 0: return own_history[-1] return 1 - own_history[-1] # EVOLVE-BLOCK-END ```
